about_the_game:
Early Access 

🎣 Dive Deep for Your Restaurant’s Success

Suit up and plunge into a vibrant underwater world where every dive is a new opportunity. In Dive and Dine Simulator, you’ll catch a wide variety of fish using specialized gear - from classic spears to high-tech traps. Explore colorful ocean zones, discover rare marine creatures, and upgrade your diving equipment to reach greater depths and reel in even bigger rewards.

🦑 From Deep Sea to Delicacies

Every catch is more than just fish - it's a gateway to culinary creativity! In Dive and Dine Simulator, transform your fresh catch into exquisite dishes that will delight your customers. Use your fishing skills to catch everything from small, tender shrimp to massive, exotic fish that only the bravest divers can reach. In the kitchen, prepare meals using realistic cooking mechanics: grill, fry, bake, and steam, each with its own intricacies. As you progress, unlock new recipes, sophisticated kitchen tools, and special ingredients that let you craft gourmet dishes.

The better the dish, the higher the tip - and the more satisfied your customers will be! Build and customize your restaurant to match your culinary vision, and create a menu that keeps customers coming back for more. Manage the dining area, deliver meals on time, and keep your guests happy to maximize your earnings.

🤿 Built for Co-Op Fun

Want to run your sea-to-table empire with friends? Dive into the co-op mode and team up! Split roles or swap around: one dives, one cooks, one serves - or tackle everything together. It’s teamwork, strategy, and chaos in the best possible way. Whether solo or with friends, there's always something to do beneath the waves.

Dive and Dine Simulator is a rich and relaxing simulation experience where exploration, creativity, and cooperation come together. Whether you're building the perfect kitchen, hunting exotic fish, or just vibing with friends - this is your chance to make a splash!

Add Dive and Dine Simulator to your wishlist now, and  become a world-class ocean chef

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
